rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for material wrapped around or covering a wound.

example.english: I cut my hand, so I’ll put on a bandage before going back to work.
example.traditional: 我隻手割親，包好條繃帶先至返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 got3 can1 baau1 hou2 tiu4 bang1 daai3 sin1 zi3 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for the adhesive-strip type of wound dressing rather than a bandage wrapped around the body.

example.english: My blister burst, so just put on a bandage and it’ll be fine.
example.traditional: 我個水泡穿咗，貼塊膠布就得啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 seoi2 paau1 cyun1 zo2 tip3 faai3 gaau1 bou3 zau6 dak1 laa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a cloth tied over someone's eyes as a blindfold.

example.english: They tied a bandage over my eyes as a blindfold.
example.traditional: 佢哋用條蒙眼布綁住我對眼，當係眼罩。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 tiu4 mung4 ngaan5 bou3 bong2 zyu6 ngo5 deoi3 ngaan5 dong3 hai6 ngaan5 zaau3
